scope: 10.1,10.3,10.4,10.4.2,10.8 framing and selected assertion/ADR reconciliation. No whole rendering certification.
source: Primary PDF physical375–379 / printed360–364; physical400–401 / printed385–386. Actual annotations: #181 physical376 replaces dated ICC reference by appropriate Table66 specification; #640 physical377 changes grey spelling to gray, not arithmetic.

features.source: Physical375/360. Conditional four-stage rendering overview; assumed devices count too; PDF halftoning is explicitly conditional. Notes distinguish simulated and simulating devices.
features.evidence: colour_paths::a_cmyk_colour_is_the_same_however_it_is_drawn only asserts inter-route consistency with quantization tolerance. It is useful regression evidence but cannot alone establish correct colorimetry, transfer order, scan conversion or all rendering stages. Detailed owners include colour_conversion, rendering_intent_transfer_current, scan_conversion_current and halftones_separations_current. T08 adds independent BG/UCR-to-CMYK-to-native-transfer arithmetic.
features.verdict: Map to stage-specific evidence; do not present the cited consistency test as a full pipeline oracle.

features.source: Headings physical376–377/361–362 add no algorithm beyond child clauses. 10.3.2 conditional recommendation for native CMYK is distinct from a CMYK blending group on an RGB output device. 10.4.2.1 recommends the ICC route while permitting classic conversions.
features.evidence: colour_conversion reviewed detailed algorithms and public consumers. Parent re-read current to_cmyk_at: DeviceRGB with Some(generation) evaluates separate; without it, the press conversion runs. ADR2549 and public transparency_groups tests distinguish explicit pair, profile-default and ICCBased-target cases.
features.verdict: Aggregate ledger prose describing RGB-to-CMYK only as a cancelling nominal identity and citing ADR1069 is stale as a description of current coverage. Detailed leaf notes later describe the actual explicit pair branch. This is an evidence-rationale qualification, not a missing runtime branch or a requested status change.

features.source: Heading physical400/385; 10.8.1 leaves generating separations to software; 10.8.3 physical401/386 defines optional simulation with SHOULD matching its steps.
features.evidence: colour_paths::two_separations_multiply_in_flat_xyz uses independent linearization/product/regamma arithmetic: two sRGB .5 separations yield 60, not merely equality to implementation. spot_planes::the_separation_is_the_drawn_page_and_off_makes_none checks list carriers and preference gating, not actual pixel output by itself. Sibling spot-plane and CPU tests supply different stages.
features.verdict: Retain optional simulation scope. The aggregate test list includes genuine independent arithmetic, but no single carrier assertion establishes the whole page output.

limits: No new tests executed in this framing shard. T08 outcomes remain in parent records.
Historical ADRs remain unchanged; successors govern current behavior.
